NiagaraService.summarize:
X.summarize(system_path) -> NiagaraSystemSummary or None
Get an AI-friendly summary of a Niagara System.

Args:
    system_path (str): Full path to the system

Returns:
    NiagaraSystemSummary or None: True if successful Example: summary = unreal.NiagaraService.summarize("/Game/VFX/NS_Fire")  # summary struct or None

    out_summary (NiagaraSystemSummary): AI-friendly system summary
NiagaraService.compile_with_results:
X.compile_with_results(system_path) -> NiagaraCompilationResult
Compile a Niagara System and return detailed compilation results with errors.
This method waits for compilation to complete and captures all error and warning messages.

Args:
    system_path (str): Full path to the system

Returns:
    NiagaraCompilationResult: Compilation result with success status, errors, and warnings Example: result = unreal.NiagaraService.compile_with_results("/Game/VFX/NS_Fire") if not result.success: print(f"Compilation failed with {result.error_count} errors:") for error in result.errors: print(f"  - {error}")
NiagaraService.get_all_editable_settings:
X.get_all_editable_settings(system_path) -> NiagaraSystemEditableSettings or None
Get ALL editable settings on a Niagara system in one call.
This includes user parameters and all rapid iteration parameters from all emitters.
Use this to discover what can be modified, then use set_parameter() or
set_rapid_iteration_param() to change values.

Args:
    system_path (str): Full path to the Niagara system

Returns:
    NiagaraSystemEditableSettings or None: True if successful Example: settings = unreal.NiagaraService.get_all_editable_settings("/Game/VFX/NS_TeslaCoil")  # settings struct or None print(f"Found {settings.total_settings_count} editable settings") # List user parameters for p in settings.user_parameters: print(f"  {p.setting_path} ({p.value_type}): {p.current_value}") # Find color settings for p in settings.rapid_iteration_parameters: if "Color" in p.setting_path: print(f"  [{p.emitter_name}] {p.display_name}: {p.current_value}")

    out_settings (NiagaraSystemEditableSettings): All editable settings organized by category

MaterialNodeService.export_material_graph:
X.export_material_graph(material_path) -> str
Export the complete material graph as a JSON string for analysis or recreation.
Maps to action="export_graph"

Returns material settings, all expressions (type, position, properties),
all connections, and material output connections — everything needed to
recreate the material from scratch.

Args:
    material_path (str): Full path to the material

Returns:
    str: JSON string of complete graph, or empty string on failure Example: json_str = unreal.MaterialNodeService.export_material_graph("/Game/M_Landscape")
MaterialNodeService.create_expression:
X.create_expression(material_path, expression_class, pos_x=0, pos_y=0) -> MaterialExpressionInfo
Create a new material expression.
Maps to action="create"

Args:
    material_path (str): Full path to the material
    expression_class (str): Class name (e.g., "Constant3Vector", "MaterialExpressionAdd")
    pos_x (int32): X position in graph
    pos_y (int32): Y position in graph

Returns:
    MaterialExpressionInfo: Created expression info (empty if failed)

ScreenshotService.capture_editor_window:
X.capture_editor_window(file_path) -> ScreenshotResult
Capture the entire Unreal Editor window to a file.
Uses Windows DWM (Desktop Window Manager) for accurate capture of DirectX content.
Works for all editor content including Blueprint graphs, material editors, etc.

Args:
    file_path (str): Output file path (PNG format recommended)

Returns:
    ScreenshotResult: Screenshot result with success status and file info
